resources.string: Notices the buttons of your remote and which app is in front (its name only), so the Home button opens Glassio, the remote buttons you choose do what you set, Recent apps lists the apps you used, Glassio comes back when you leave an app it opened and waits while the TV asks to allow USB debugging, and a camera or the doorbell can show over another app. It does not read what is on the screen or what you type, and collects nothing.
